security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: https://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://ipc.localhost; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC and Telnet client
bundle.longDescription: Submarine is a free, open-source SSH and SFTP client with RDP, VNC and Telnet. It puts a terminal, a dual-pane SFTP browser, port forwarding, folder mirror, server info and Docker panels, monitoring and remote desktops in one native window, with encrypted profiles and optional cloud sync.
